label: First Monday report calibration control
paraphrase: For a fair coin experiment and exactly one designated first-Monday assessment per experiment, every constant forecast report r has Heads conditional one half. A constant one-third report is therefore not calibrated for this designated cohort. The constant Sunday and constant first-Monday coin reports structurally retain one another in this reduced two-world model. This monitor control does not assume its information or reference class is Beauty's centered evidence.
